packet: H4b2 finite compound sales invoice tax dependency
scope: One compound proportional sales-tax component on a sales invoice issue, depending on exactly one H4b1 aggregate proportional tax output from that issue.
The H4b1 basis is the sum of currency-rounded pre-tax sales_invoice_line amounts.
tax1 = currency_round(basis * selected aggregate rate); tax2 = currency_round((basis + already-rounded tax1.amount) * selected compound rate).
The issue owns sibling outputs. The compound output posts its own customer receivable, invoice outstanding, and selected tax-authority payable; it adds no cash or stock effect.

mechanism.input: compound_tax_components carries tax_key, tax_claim_account, rule_version, and predecessor_tax_key; the key is matched to the issue's sole aggregate component.
mechanism.refresh_order: The required-output recipe emits aggregate basis, aggregate tax, then compound tax. The managed table is registered before aggregate tax and basis tables, so obsolete compound output is deleted before its REJECT-protected predecessor and basis. Removal and issue deletion probes passed.
mechanism.typed_source_reference_limit: SurrealDB 3.2.0 rejects REFERENCE on nested sales_invoice_issue.compound_tax_components.*.predecessor. The source therefore selects its predecessor with a component key; the managed compound child constructs the same-issue typed output reference.

checks: Rounded line amounts 3.33 and 4.44 produce basis 7.77; the raw combined amount would round to 7.78.
Independent reconstruction verifies the basis, aggregate tax1, compound tax2, customer receivable, invoice outstanding, and both tax-authority payables.

The full source/output/root oracle and physical stock/treasury snapshots are rechecked after issue creation, each successful line/rule edit, compound-only removal/re-addition, paired component removal/re-addition, and issue deletion.
Line edit, removal, and addition refresh both outputs; aggregate version/amount changes refresh compound output with no compound source edit.
Aggregate and compound version changes retain their stable output IDs; exact selected versions are stored on output rows.

Positive compound rates that round to zero, missing/self/reverse/foreign predecessor keys, duplicate components/keys, missing aggregate predecessor, fixed rules, and key/account/currency/date mismatches reject atomically.
A downstream customer net ceiling rejects a line edit and restores the source, all derived children, and all affected roots.

Compound-only removal/re-addition retains its predecessor and preserves its output ID; removing both components deletes the compound before its predecessor, and issue deletion prunes every child/root.
Physical stock and treasury snapshots remain unchanged.
probe.predecessor_scope: Only an aggregate tax key from the same issue can be selected. Self/reverse and cross-issue record references are not representable in the source input; invalid keys reject, and the managed output stores a typed same-issue reference.

regression_controls.result: passed; H4b1 aggregate basis and H4a/manual routes remain working
passed; fixed/proportional parent-local tax and H3a manual routes remain working
passed; ten typed levels, bounded branch, reactive reparent and rollback

limits: Disposable in-memory correctness fixture only; no production migration or deployed-profile cutover is claimed.

Exactly one aggregate proportional predecessor and one compound proportional component per sales invoice issue; no general DAG, arbitrary expression, cycles, compound-to-compound dependency, or multi-document grouping.
No statutory interpretation, recoverability, withholding/collection, offsets, remittance, purchase tax migration, or tax-law claim is made.
The nested source input stores a predecessor tax key because this SurrealDB version rejects nested REFERENCE fields; the managed output itself uses a typed reference.
